title: Plan Ticketly's audit
prompt: You have been asked to audit Ticketly against WCAG 2.2 AA before the festival's ticket launch. Put the audit steps in the order you would carry them out.
hints: You can't choose pages until you know what you are auditing against and which flows matter.
Do the cheap, fast automated checks before the slower manual passes, so the manual testers aren't distracted by missing labels.
Testing ends with a sweep of the visual and content checks the tool and the two passes don't cover. The report comes after all testing, and the work isn't finished until fixes are retested.
explanation: An audit starts by fixing its **scope and target**, so everyone agrees what "done" means. The **sample** then picks representative pages and complete flows. **Automated scans** come first among the tests because they are fast and clear away the obvious problems. The **keyboard pass** precedes the **screen reader pass** because keyboard failures (unreachable controls, traps) block screen reader testing too. **Visual and content checks** cover what neither tool reveals. The **report** prioritises by impact, and the cycle closes with fixes, a **retest** of the same flows and an updated accessibility statement.

items.scope: Agree the scope and target: WCAG 2.2 AA, the browsers and assistive technologies, and the key flows
items.sample: Choose a sample: home, event page, checkout and account pages, plus the complete booking flow
items.automated: Run axe on every sampled page and state, including open dialogs and form errors
items.keyboard: Do a keyboard pass through every flow: reach, see, operate, escape
items.screen-reader: Repeat the flows with NVDA and Chrome, VoiceOver and Safari, and VoiceOver on iOS
items.visual-content: Check 400% zoom, text spacing, reduced motion, alt text quality, headings and language
items.report: Write findings with location, WCAG criterion, severity and fix, and prioritise blockers in key flows
items.retest: Fix the issues, retest the same flows and update the accessibility statement
